sloka: ततस्ते त्वरितास्तस्य राक्षसा रावणाज्ञया ।मद्यकुम्भांश्च विविधान् क्षिप्रमेवोपहारयन् ।। ६.६०.९३ ।।।।
transliteration: tataste tvaritāstasya rākṣasā rāvaṇājñayā ।madyakumbhāṁśca vividhān kṣipramevopahārayan ।। 6.60.93 ।।।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna surrounded by Rakshasas going to his brother's abode happily looked like the Lord of death bent on destroying the creation. He took strides which shook the earth.
